# P5 Home Co

> P5 Home Co is the operating parent company behind five specialized
> home-service companies serving Boise and the Treasure Valley in Idaho:
> Boise Construction Co, Boise Remodeling Co, Boise ADU Co, Boise Handyman
> Co, and Boise Cabinet Co. It is an operating family of companies, not a
> directory or a referral network.

## What P5 Home Co is

P5 Home Co brings every chapter of homeownership under one family of
specialized companies. Each company has its own craft, team, and
expertise. What connects them is a shared operating standard: clear
written scopes, one accountable team per project, proactive
communication about decisions and budget impacts, and a connected
handoff when a project needs more than one specialty.

Established 2020. Bonded and insured. Serving Ada and Canyon counties.

## The five companies

- [Boise Construction Co](https://boiseconstruction.co): New home
  building. Custom homes, semi-custom homes, building on your own lot,
  and home design and plans. Design, engineering, permitting, and
  construction stay with one accountable team.
- [Boise Remodeling Co](https://boiseremodeling.co): Design-build
  remodeling. Kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, whole-home
  remodeling, additions, and ADUs, managed under one roof with a written
  scope and coordinated permits.
- Boise ADU Co (boiseadu.co, launching soon): Accessory dwelling units.
  Detached ADUs, garage conversions, basement and interior units, and
  feasibility and permitting. The website is not live yet; enquiries go
  to (208) 477-1169.
- [Boise Handyman Co](https://boisehandyman.co): Home repair and
  maintenance. Drywall and trim repair, TV and fixture mounting, deck and
  exterior repair, and general home maintenance.
- [Boise Cabinet Co](https://boisecabinet.co): Custom cabinetry. Premium
  frameless kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, built-ins and storage,
  and whole-home cabinetry, designed, built, and installed.

## Which company handles which project

- Building a new home, or building on land you already own: Boise
  Construction Co.
- Renovating, adding on to, or changing how an existing home works:
  Boise Remodeling Co.
- Adding a guest suite, rental unit, or multigenerational living space on
  land you already own: Boise ADU Co.
- Repairs, installations, finish work, and smaller home projects: Boise
  Handyman Co.
- Cabinetry, vanities, built-ins, and coordinated storage: Boise Cabinet
  Co.

A single project can involve more than one company. A complete kitchen
transformation, for example, runs through Boise Remodeling Co for layout,
permits, demolition, and construction; Boise Cabinet Co for cabinet
design, fabrication, and installation; and Boise Handyman Co for final
mounting, finish work, and punch-list items.

## Service area

Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, and Caldwell, across
Ada and Canyon counties in Idaho's Treasure Valley.
